title: 第十二课 · 她不在
subtitle: Lesson 12 — 她不在 · She is not here

items.py: wèi
items.en: hello (on the phone)

items.py: wèi
items.en: polite measure word for people

items.py: zhǎo
items.en: to look for

items.py: huí
items.en: to return

items.py: děng
items.en: to wait

items.py: liú
items.en: to leave (behind)

items.py: kǒuxìn
items.en: verbal message

items.py: kěyǐ
items.en: may; can (permission or possibility)

items.py: tóngxué
items.en: classmate

items.py: dǎ diànhuà
items.en: to make a phone call

items.py: huí lái
items.en: to come back

items.py: gàosu
items.en: to tell

items.py: wǎnshang
items.en: evening; night

items.py: yíhuìr
items.en: a moment; a little while

items.py: Wèi, qǐngwèn Wáng Lán zài ma?
items.en: Hello, is Wang Lan there, please?

items.py: Tā bú zài.
items.en: She's not here.

items.py: Qǐng tā gěi wǒ huí diànhuà.
items.en: Please ask her to call me back.

items.py: Nín shì nǎ wèi?
items.en: May I ask who is calling?

items.py: Wǒ shì tā tóngxué.
items.en: I'm her classmate.

items.py: Qǐngwèn nín zhǎo shéi?
items.en: Who are you looking for, please?

items.py: Wǒ kěyǐ liú ge kǒuxìn ma?
items.en: May I leave a message?

items.py: Tā wǎnshang huí lái.
items.en: She'll come back this evening.

items.py: Mǎlì: Wèi, qǐngwèn Wáng Lán zài ma?
items.en: Mary: Hello, is Wang Lan there, please?

items.zh: 王兰的妈妈：她不在。请问您是哪位？
items.py: Wáng Lán de māma: Tā bú zài. Qǐngwèn nín shì nǎ wèi?
items.en: Wang Lan's mother: She's not in. May I ask who is calling?

items.py: Mǎlì: Wǒ shì tā tóngxué Mǎlì.
items.en: Mary: I'm her classmate Mary.

items.zh: 王兰的妈妈：您找她有事吗？
items.py: Wáng Lán de māma: Nín zhǎo tā yǒu shì ma?
items.en: Wang Lan's mother: Are you looking for her about something?

items.zh: 玛丽：对。请她给我回电话，好吗？
items.py: Mǎlì: Duì. Qǐng tā gěi wǒ huí diànhuà, hǎo ma?
items.en: Mary: Yes. Please ask her to call me back, OK?

items.zh: 王兰的妈妈：好的。她晚上回来，我告诉她。
items.py: Wáng Lán de māma: Hǎo de. Tā wǎnshang huí lái, wǒ gàosu tā.
items.en: Wang Lan's mother: All right. She'll be back this evening; I'll tell her.

items.py: Mǎlì: Xièxie!
items.en: Mary: Thank you!

items.py: Wáng Lán de māma: Bú kèqi.
items.en: Wang Lan's mother: You're welcome.

items.zh: 职员：喂，您好！请问您找谁？
items.py: Zhíyuán: Wèi, nín hǎo! Qǐngwèn nín zhǎo shéi?
items.en: Staff: Hello! Who are you looking for, please?

items.zh: 大卫：请问李老师办公室的电话是多少？我想找李老师。
items.py: Dàwèi: Qǐngwèn Lǐ lǎoshī bàngōngshì de diànhuà shì duōshao? Wǒ xiǎng zhǎo Lǐ lǎoshī.
items.en: David: What's the phone number for Teacher Li's office? I'd like to reach Teacher Li.

items.zh: 职员：李老师不在，他出去一会儿。
items.py: Zhíyuán: Lǐ lǎoshī bú zài, tā chūqù yíhuìr.
items.en: Staff: Teacher Li isn't in; he stepped out for a moment.

items.zh: 大卫：我可以留个口信吗？
items.py: Dàwèi: Wǒ kěyǐ liú ge kǒuxìn ma?
items.en: David: May I leave a message?

items.py: Zhíyuán: Kěyǐ. Qǐng shuō.
items.en: Staff: Yes, go ahead.

items.zh: 大卫：请告诉他给我回电话。我叫大卫。
items.py: Dàwèi: Qǐng gàosu tā gěi wǒ huí diànhuà. Wǒ jiào Dàwèi.
items.en: David: Please tell him to call me back. My name is David.

items.zh: 职员：好的，我等李老师回来告诉他。
items.py: Zhíyuán: Hǎo de, wǒ děng Lǐ lǎoshī huí lái gàosu tā.
items.en: Staff: OK, I'll tell him when Teacher Li comes back.

items.py: Dàwèi: Xièxie!
items.en: David: Thank you!

items.py: Qǐng tā gěi wǒ huí diànhuà.
items.en: 给 as preposition "for / to": ask her to return the call to me.

items.py: Wǒ gěi tā yī běn shū.
items.en: I give her a book. (给 = to, toward the recipient)

items.py: Māma gěi wǒ zuò fàn.
items.en: Mom cooks for me.

items.py: Tā wǎnshang huí lái.
items.en: Directional complement 回来: "return" toward the speaker's place (come back).

items.py: Wǒ huí xuéxiào qù.
items.en: I go back to school. (回去 = go back away from speaker)

items.py: Qǐng jìnlái.
items.en: Please come in. (进来 = enter toward here)

items.py: Wǒ kěyǐ jìnlái ma?
items.en: May I come in? (可以 = permission)

items.py: Zhèr bù kěyǐ chōuyān.
items.en: You can't smoke here.

items.zh: 喂，请问王兰在吗？→喂，请问李老师在吗？
items.py: Wèi, qǐngwèn Wáng Lán zài ma? → Wèi, qǐngwèn Lǐ lǎoshī zài ma?
items.en: Is Wang Lan there? → Is Teacher Li there?

items.zh: 请问您找谁？→请问您找王兰吗？
items.py: Qǐngwèn nín zhǎo shéi? → Qǐngwèn nín zhǎo Wáng Lán ma?
items.en: Who are you looking for? → Are you looking for Wang Lan?

items.zh: 我是她同学。→我是她朋友。
items.py: Wǒ shì tā tóngxué. → Wǒ shì tā péngyou.
items.en: I'm her classmate. → I'm her friend.

items.zh: 请她给我回电话。→请他给我回电话。
items.py: Qǐng tā gěi wǒ huí diànhuà. → Qǐng tā gěi wǒ huí diànhuà.
items.en: Ask her to call me back. → Ask him to call me back.

items.py: Tā bú zài. → Tā zài.
items.en: She's not in. → He is in.

items.zh: 我可以留个口信吗？→我可以等一下吗？
items.py: Wǒ kěyǐ liú ge kǒuxìn ma? → Wǒ kěyǐ děng yíxià ma?
items.en: May I leave a message? → May I wait a moment?

items.py: Wǒ gàosu tā. → Wǒ gàosu tā.
items.en: I'll tell her. → I'll tell him.

items.zh: 她晚上回来。→她一会儿回来。
items.py: Tā wǎnshang huí lái. → Tā yíhuìr huí lái.
items.en: She'll be back this evening. → She'll be back in a moment.

items.py: Wèi, qǐngwèn Zhāng lǎoshī zài jiā ma?
items.en: Hello, is Teacher Zhang home, please?

items.py: Tā bú zài, qǐngwèn nín shì nǎ wèi?
items.en: He's not in. May I ask who is calling?

items.py: Qǐng gěi wǒ māma dǎ ge diànhuà.
items.en: Please call my mom for me.

items.zh: 王老师不在办公室，您可以留个口信。
items.py: Wáng lǎoshī bú zài bàngōngshì, nín kěyǐ liú ge kǒuxìn.
items.en: Teacher Wang isn't in the office; you may leave a message.

items.py: Wǒ děng tā huí lái.
items.en: I'll wait until she comes back.

items.zh: 您可以告诉他明天上课吗？
items.py: Nín kěyǐ gàosu tā míngtiān shàng kè ma?
items.en: Could you tell him there's class tomorrow?

items.py: Qǐngwèn nín zhǎo shéi? Wǒ zhǎo Mǎlì.
items.en: Who are you looking for? I'm looking for Mary.

items.py: Wǎnshang wǒ gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà.
items.en: I'll call you this evening.
